description: Defines the DdlVisibleAttribute class, an attribute used to specify visibility and capabilities related to DDL for fields or properties within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace.

classes.name: DdlVisibleAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class indicating whether a field or property is visible in DDL and whether it can have values added or removed.

methods.name: DdlVisibleAttribute()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with visibility set to true.

methods.name: DdlVisibleAttribute(bool visible)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a specified visibility.
